Scene 03 / Why work with me

Why brands work with me

Multi-skilled, not one-trick

Comfortable across styles and niches, from clean product demos to scrappy, native-feeling UGC. You get content built for your brand, not a template reused for every client.

A track record that performs

700+ short-form videos created and 10M+ combined views for the brands I've worked with.

Built for the platform, not around it

Every video opens with a strong hook and native storytelling, so it performs like organic content on TikTok, Reels, and Shorts instead of reading as an ad.

Fast turnaround, zero chasing

Most videos are delivered within 24–48 hours, with clear updates along the way so nothing stalls waiting on me.

Terms of Service

Starter draft, not legal advice. Have this reviewed by a lawyer before you publish it, especially the usage-rights and payment sections, so it actually matches how you work.

Services

I create short-form UGC video content for brands based on an agreed brief. Deliverables, format, and quantity are confirmed in writing before work begins.

Usage rights

The base fee covers organic usage by the client on their own social channels. Paid amplification, whitelisting, spark ads, or usage beyond the agreed term require a separate licensing fee, agreed in advance.

Revisions

Each project includes one round of revisions based on the original brief. Requests outside the original scope may incur an additional fee.

Payment

A deposit of 50% is due before work begins, with the balance due on delivery. Payment is accepted by bank transfer or PayPal. Invoices unpaid more than 14 days after delivery may incur a 5% late fee.

Turnaround

Standard turnaround is 2-5 business days from final brief approval. Rush delivery may be available for an additional fee.

Ownership

Raw footage remains mine unless otherwise agreed in writing. The client receives full rights to the final edited deliverable for the agreed usage term.

Cancellation

If a project is cancelled after work has started, the deposit is non-refundable and covers time already spent. Rescheduling requests are accommodated with at least 48 hours' notice where possible.

Liability

My liability for any claim arising from a project is limited to the amount paid for that project. I'm not liable for indirect or consequential losses, including lost profits or ad spend.

Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of Italy.

Privacy Policy

Starter draft, not legal advice. Have this reviewed before you publish it, and update it if you add analytics, cookies, or a different contact method.

What I collect

When you contact me by email or through this site, I collect the information you provide, such as your name, email address, and the contents of your message.

How it's used

Your information is used only to respond to your inquiry and, if we work together, to manage that project. It is not sold or shared with third parties.

Data retention

I keep inquiry and project information for as long as reasonably needed for business and tax purposes, then delete it.

Cookies & analytics

This site does not currently use cookies or analytics tracking. If that changes, this policy will be updated to reflect it.

Your rights

You can ask what information I hold about you, or ask me to delete it, by emailing alecollabsugc@gmail.com.
